texts.title: Text A: Millbrook Leisure Centre, Swimming Pool Information

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
OPENING HOURS: Monday to Friday 6.30 am to 9.00 pm. Saturday and Sunday 8.00 am to 6.00 pm. Closed on public holidays.

SESSIONS: Lane swimming only, Monday, Wednesday and Friday 6.30 am to 9.00 am. Family sessions: Saturday 10.00 am to 12 noon. Children under 8 must be accompanied in the water by an adult. Quiet swim (adults only): Tuesday and Thursday 7.00 pm to 8.00 pm.

PRICES: Adult £4.50. Child (5 to 15) £2.50. Under 5s free. Senior (over 60) £3.00. Ten-visit card £36.

RULES: Please shower before entering the pool. No running on the poolside. Swimming caps must be worn during lane swimming. Lockers require a £1 coin, which is returned afterwards. Photography is not permitted. Lifeguards are on duty at all times.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text:
EXPLORE THE COAST BY BIKE!

Hire rates: £6 per hour, £18 for a half day (4 hours), £28 for a full day. Child seats are available for an extra £3. Helmets are provided free with every hire.

Opening times: daily from 9.00 am to 5.00 pm, April to October. Weekends only from November to March.

All bikes must be returned by 5.30 pm. Late returns will be charged an extra £10. A £50 deposit is required for each bike. Groups of six or more receive a 10% discount. Online bookings are guaranteed; walk-in customers are served subject to availability.

texts.title: Text C: Greenfield Council Recycling Guide

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text:
GREEN BINS are collected every second Thursday. Please put your bin out by 7.00 am.

ACCEPTED: paper, card, metal cans and plastic bottles (please rinse).
NOT ACCEPTED: plastic bags, polystyrene and food waste. Glass should be taken to the bottle bank in the supermarket car park.

GARDEN WASTE (brown bin): collected April to November. Annual fee: £40.

LARGE ITEMS: free collection of up to two items a month. Please book in advance.

MISSED COLLECTIONS: please report within 48 hours.
